mapper.select: SELECT sys_ai_role_prompt_id AS id, user_id AS userId, role_id AS roleId, prompt_mode AS promptMode, sys_ai_role_prompt_content AS content, sys_ai_role_prompt_status AS status, sys_ai_role_prompt_delete AS deleted FROM sys_ai_role_prompt WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND prompt_mode = #{promptMode} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_ai_role_prompt SET sys_ai_role_prompt_content = #{content}, sys_ai_role_prompt_status = #{status}, sys_ai_role_prompt_delete = 0 WHERE sys_ai_role_prompt_id = #{id}
